name: Qunkasaura
sum: Qunkasaura is a saltasauroid titanosaur from the Lo Hueco site in Spain, known from a partial skeleton found in a bonebed in 2007.
wsnote: No body-size figure was read in the sources consulted.
holotype: A partial skeleton of a single individual from the Lo Hueco bonebed (HUE-02957 per the image label).
biology: No biological statement was read in the sources consulted.
author: Mocho et al. 2024
